reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Grip giving out before your back does is one of the most common sticking points on pull-ups, and it's fixable. Work on dead hangs for time, build up to a few sets, and add some heavy carries and towel or thick-bar holds. Pull-ups themselves also help: use a grip you can hold, and keep your reps controlled so you're not spending your grip on the way down. If your hands or forearms are sore or painful, that's a different matter and worth checking with a doctor. Otherwise, want me to build a program around pull-up strength?"}
